title: MAP-S01-02 - Overturned Vendor Cart Scene Board

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: A vendor cart blocks the bend. Scattered fruit, broken jars, torn canvas, and muddy wheel ruts make the road feel suddenly too narrow. Something moves on the far side.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: A vendor cart blocks the bend. Scattered fruit, broken jars, torn canvas, and muddy wheel ruts make the road feel suddenly too narrow. Something moves on the far side.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Use this as an investigation board: orient the blocked road, let the table inspect the wreck, and route the far-side movement into the creature reveal.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Non-combat board. If players attack into the underbrush, switch to MAP-COMBAT-S01-03.
Keep the creature as movement and sound until S01-03 unless players push directly to the far side.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "Use the board like a crime scene. Point to where the carriage stops, where the cart blocks the road, and where the feeding sound comes from. Then ask: who checks the cart, who checks the body, and who watches the far side?"

sections.title: State controls
items: slitThroatDiscovered Slit throat discovered checkbox Use this for later story coherence.
brambleSeedFound Bramble seed found checkbox Seed only; do not resolve in Act 1.
